svg.title: Contribution city
svg.desc: An isometric night skyline built from atty57's GitHub contributions: one building per day of the last year, taller and brighter for busier days. 472 contributions across 73 active days, busiest on 2026-10-07 with 42.

g.text: peak 42 on Oct 7 · streak 20d · longest 20d · active 73 days
